schema.title: P31 UI Forge — constrained component-tree schema
schema.description: Registry-derived schema for Dreamer output. 34 components (34 unique) from design-core + canon. Emitted by scripts/gen-ui-schema.mjs.

dataBinding.description: backend data path this node consumes (Grounder-derived).

props.description: props must satisfy the named component contract.

variant.description: Semantic tone. success/warning/error/info map to the four status colours.

items.description: Navigation items with icon, label, and href

variant.description: Visual emphasis. primary = main action, secondary = alternative, ghost = tertiary.

size.description: Control size. Affects padding, font, and touch target.

disabled.description: When true, the button is not interactive and renders aria-disabled.

loading.description: When true, sets aria-busy and blocks interaction. Renders a spinner before the label in default (non-asChild) mode.

spoons.description: Current spoon level; overlay renders only at 0

items.description: Searchable items: { id, label, description?, icon?, keywords? }

onSelect.description: Called with the selected item id

columns.description: Footer column groups with title and links

children.description: Content to render inside the panel

onSelect.description: Called with the selected section id

items.description: Nav items: { path, label, emoji?, flagship? }

center.description: Center region: command trigger, nav, or context
